summary: Prairie Operating Co. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Citibank as administrative agent, effective June 30, 2026. The amendment relaxes the current ratio covenant for fiscal quarters ending June 30, September 30, and December 31, 2026, and introduces a new minimum hydrocarbon production covenant measured over rolling three-month periods starting August 31, 2026. This is a routine credit agreement modification, not a special situation. The filing also references a Series F Convertible Preferred Stock Letter Agreement, but no terms are provided. No special-situation category applies.
